payload.name: Photo 600x600 Under 100KB by PrintableTools Lab
payload.short_description: Free no-signup 600 x 600 square photo workflow for 100KB upload limits.
payload.long_description: A free browser-based 600 x 600 photo under 100KB workflow for profile, school, marketplace, application, and admin upload forms that require exact square pixels plus a small KB cap. It keeps ordinary files local during use and includes an optional USD 9 Upload Limit Fix Plan request after a public-safe fit check.
